name: io.github.emog33k/winrdp-mcp
description: Zero-config server to provision and administer any Windows RDP box over WinRM/SSH/SMB.

runtimeArguments.description: Run the MCP server in controller mode (stdio).

environmentVariables.name: WINRDP_VAULT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Fernet key to encrypt the host inventory at rest. Omit to use a machine-local key file.

environmentVariables.name: WINRDP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile to expose: full (default), dynamic, admin, rdp, or core. 'dynamic' starts lean and loads tool groups on demand via enable_toolset.

environmentVariables.name: WINRDP_CONFIRM_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to require operator confirmation (via MCP elicitation) before any destructive tool runs. Clients without elicitation fall back to their own destructiveHint gating.

environmentVariables.name: WINRDP_DEFAULT_WINRM_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Default WinRM auth for add_host when not specified: 'ntlm' (default) or 'basic'. Set to 'basic' when your operator network is behind a proxy/VPN that breaks NTLM.
